definitions: To take in and understand fully (information or ideas).
To absorb and integrate (people, ideas, or culture) into a wider society or culture.
To become similar to one's environment or to another person or thing.
To absorb food and turn it into a part of the body itself.
examples: It takes time to assimilate new information.
Immigrants often assimilate into their new country.
The plant assimilates nutrients from the soil.
